title: Functional multimodal action-conditioned persistence across a hidden feedback boundary
question: Can the integrated multimodal PLM carry an unobserved environment feedback bit from a post-q1 action boundary into a later q2 computation, while retaining complementary multimodal state?
hypothesis: With fixed entity addressing and fixed Boolean operator dispatch, a label-free multimodal persistent state can solve a q2 task that is XOR-masked by a hidden post-q1 environment feedback bit; removing or flipping that feedback write should materially reduce q2 accuracy toward chance.

arms.name: normal
arms.intervention: full multimodal state plus true post-q1 feedback write

arms.name: no_feedback_write
arms.intervention: post-q1 feedback replaced by zero before the state update; q2 target still uses true feedback

arms.name: flip_feedback_write
arms.intervention: post-q1 feedback replaced by one-minus-true feedback before state update; q2 target still uses true feedback

arms.name: no_memory
arms.intervention: zero persistent state immediately before q1

arms.name: shuffle_image
arms.intervention: permute image observations across observed entities

arms.name: text_only
arms.intervention: replace image and audio with constants

arms.name: image_only
arms.intervention: replace text and audio with constants

arms.name: audio_only
arms.intervention: replace text and image with constants

information_flow.pre_q1: text/image/audio observations -> encoders -> shared representation -> explicit persistent entity write -> q1 read -> fixed CASM -> q1 action
information_flow.feedback_boundary: q1 action -> environment emits hidden feedback bit -> verifier/update -> persistent entity state
information_flow.q2: updated persistent state -> q2 read -> fixed CASM -> q2 action
information_flow.operator_identity: public query metadata; learned operator discovery is out of scope for this functional lane

held_constant: same multimodal generator surfaces and entity count as E2E-005
same hidden_dim, optimizer, learning rate, weight decay, five seeds and 300-step schedule
same fixed entity addressing and public operator dispatch
no auxiliary payload-bit or entity-label supervision
evaluation episodes generated after all training steps
no evaluation-driven early stopping or selection
all controls reuse the exact same evaluation episode objects and hidden feedback bits
previous E2E results are provenance only and do not determine hyperparameters or thresholds
leakage_rules: q1 and q2 target the same entity, but query bit pairs are disjoint
the hidden feedback bit is not encoded in any observation modality
the hidden feedback bit is generated only at the environment boundary after q1 action
q2 target is derived from true hidden feedback and q2 payload bits only
feedback write controls alter only the state update input, never the registered q2 target
model query API exposes only memory, entity, bit indices and public operator
model update API receives feedback only after q1 action
training and evaluation semantic keys include payload, query compositions, entities and hidden feedback
training/evaluation semantic overlap must be zero
all evaluation control arms use identical episode objects
action loss is computed by the outer harness; model API never receives action targets

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass, primary mean q2 >= 0.80, every seed >= 0.40, and normal - no_feedback_write >= 0.20
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence for action-conditioned hidden-feedback persistence in the registered synthetic multimodal mechanism
decision_rule.does_not_license: real-world multimodal reasoning, lifelong memory, learned addressing/operator discovery, scaling or AGI

decision_rule.condition: integrity passes but primary threshold fails
decision_rule.licenses: the registered fixed configuration does not establish the capability
decision_rule.does_not_license: architecture impossibility or permission to tune on this evaluation

decision_rule.condition: integrity passes, primary succeeds but feedback-write ablations do not materially degrade
decision_rule.licenses: capability may be obtainable without causal feedback storage; the persistence mechanism is not identified by this benchmark

decision_rule.condition: any leakage, oracle, split, or gradient gate fails

statistics.primary_aggregation: mean q2 per seed followed by seed-level bootstrap

scope: explicit entity addressing is a functional scaffold
fixed public Boolean operator dispatch is a functional scaffold
hidden feedback bit is exogenous and intentionally not present in any modality
no optimization sweep is part of this experiment

provenance.predecessor_use: only the independently discovered causal-scope limitation is used to motivate this protocol; no E2E-005 outcome is used for tuning
